verses.en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
verses.pt: Jesus, pois, vendo as multidões, subiu ao monte; e, tendo se assentado, aproximaram-se os seus discípulos,
verses.en_web: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
verses.en_bbe: And seeing great masses of people he went up into the mountain; and when he was seated his disciples came to him.

verses.en: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
verses.pt: e ele se pôs a ensiná-los, dizendo:
verses.en_web: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And with these words he gave them teaching, saying,

verses.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os humildes de espírito, porque deles é o reino dos céus.
verses.en_web: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are the poor in spirit: for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.

verses.en: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os que choram, porque eles serão consolados.
verses.en_web: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are those who are sad: for they will be comforted.

verses.en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os mansos, porque eles herdarão a terra.
verses.en_web: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are the gentle: for the earth will be their heritage.

verses.en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os que têm fome e sede de justiça porque eles serão fartos.
verses.en_web: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are those whose heart's desire is for righteousness: for they will have their desire.

verses.en: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os misericordiosos, porque eles alcançarão misericórdia.
verses.en_web: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are those who have mercy: for they will be given mercy.

verses.en: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os limpos de coração, porque eles verão a Deus.
verses.en_web: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are the clean in heart: for they will see God.

verses.en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os pacificadores, porque eles serão chamados filhos de Deus.
verses.en_web: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are the peacemakers: for they will be named sons of God.

verses.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os que são perseguidos por causa da justiça, porque deles é o reino dos céus.
verses.en_web: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are those who are attacked on account of righteousness: for the kingdom of heaven will be theirs.

verses.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados sois vós, quando vos injuriarem e perseguiram e, mentindo, disserem todo mal contra vós por minha causa.
verses.en_web: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are you when men give you a bad name, and are cruel to you, and say all evil things against you falsely, because of me.

verses.en: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.pt: Alegrai-vos e exultai, porque é grande o vosso galardão nos céus; porque assim perseguiram aos profetas que foram antes de vós.
verses.en_web: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
verses.en_bbe: Be glad and full of joy; for great is your reward in heaven: for so were the prophets attacked who were before you.

verses.en: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.pt: Vós sois o sal da terra; mas se o sal se tornar insípido, com que se há de restaurar-lhe o sabor? para nada mais presta, senão para ser lançado fora, e ser pisado pelos homens.
verses.en_web: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
verses.en_bbe: You are the salt of the earth; but if its taste goes from the salt, how will you make it salt again? it is then good for nothing but to be put out and crushed under foot by men.

verses.en: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.pt: Vós sois a luz do mundo. Não se pode esconder uma cidade situada sobre um monte;
verses.en_web: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
verses.en_bbe: You are the light of the world. A town put on a hill may be seen by all.

verses.en: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.pt: nem os que acendem uma candeia a colocam debaixo do alqueire, mas no velador, e assim ilumina a todos que estão na casa.
verses.en_web: Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
verses.en_bbe: And a burning light is not put under a vessel, but on its table; so that its rays may be shining on all who are in the house.

verses.en: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.pt: Assim resplandeça a vossa luz diante dos homens, para que vejam as vossas boas obras, e glorifiquem a vosso Pai, que está nos céus.
verses.en_web: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Even so let your light be shining before men, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.

verses.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.pt: Não penseis que vim destruir a lei ou os profetas; não vim destruir, mas cumprir.
verses.en_web: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
verses.en_bbe: Let there be no thought that I have come to put an end to the law or the prophets. I have not come for destruction, but to make complete.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.pt: Porque em verdade vos digo que, até que o céu e a terra passem, de modo nenhum passará da lei um só i ou um só til, até que tudo seja cumprido.
verses.en_web: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, Till heaven and earth come to an end, not the smallest letter or part of a letter will in any way be taken from the law, till all things are done.

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.pt: Qualquer, pois, que violar um destes mandamentos, por menor que seja, e assim ensinar aos homens, será chamado o menor no reino dos céus; aquele, porém, que os cumprir e ensinar será chamado grande no reino dos céus.
verses.en_web: Whoever, therefore, shall break one of these least commandments, and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Whoever then goes against the smallest of these laws, teaching men to do the same, will be named least in the kingdom of heaven; but he who keeps the laws, teaching others to keep them, will be named great in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.en: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.pt: Pois eu vos digo que, se a vossa justiça não exceder a dos escribas e fariseus, de modo nenhum entrareis no reino dos céus.
verses.en_web: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.en_bbe: For I say to you, If your righteousness is not greater than the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never go into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.pt: Ouvistes que foi dito aos antigos: Não matarás; e, Quem matar será réu de juízo.
verses.en_web: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
verses.en_bbe: You have knowledge that it was said in old times, You may not put to death; and, Whoever puts to death will be in danger of being judged:

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que todo aquele que se encolerizar contra seu irmão, será réu de juízo; e quem disser a seu irmão: Raca, será réu diante do sinédrio; e quem lhe disser: Tolo, será réu do fogo do inferno.
verses.en_web: But I tell you, that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment; and whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council; and whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother will be in danger of being judged; and he who says to his brother, Raca, will be in danger from the Sanhedrin; and whoever says, You foolish one, will be in danger of the hell of fire.

verses.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
verses.pt: Portanto, se estiveres apresentando a tua oferta no altar, e aí te lembrares de que teu irmão tem alguma coisa contra ti,
verses.en_web: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
verses.en_bbe: If then you are making an offering at the altar and there it comes to your mind that your brother has something against you,

verses.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.pt: deixa ali diante do altar a tua oferta, e vai conciliar-te primeiro com teu irmão, e depois vem apresentar a tua oferta.
verses.en_web: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
verses.en_bbe: While your offering is still before the altar, first go and make peace with your brother, then come and make your offering.

verses.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.pt: Concilia-te depressa com o teu adversário, enquanto estás no caminho com ele; para que não aconteça que o adversário te entregue ao guarda, e sejas lançado na prisão.
verses.en_web: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
verses.en_bbe: Come to an agreement quickly with him who has a cause against you at law, while you are with him on the way, for fear that he may give you up to the judge and the judge may give you to the police and you may be put into prison.

verses.en: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.pt: Em verdade te digo que de maneira nenhuma sairás dali enquanto não pagares o último ceitil.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, You will not come out from there till you have made payment of the very last farthing.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.pt: Ouvistes que foi dito: Não adulterarás.
verses.en_web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
verses.en_bbe: You have knowledge that it was said, You may not have connection with another man's wife:

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que todo aquele que olhar para uma mulher para a cobiçar, já em seu coração cometeu adultério com ela.
verses.en_web: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you that everyone whose eyes are turned on a woman with desire has had connection with her in his heart.

verses.en: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.pt: Se o teu olho direito te faz tropeçar, arranca-o e lança-o de ti; pois te é melhor que se perca um dos teus membros do que seja todo o teu corpo lançado no inferno.
verses.en_web: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
verses.en_bbe: And if your right eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out and put it away from you; because it is better to undergo the loss of one part, than for all your body to go into hell.

verses.en: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut if off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.pt: E, se a tua mão direita te faz tropeçar, corta-a e lança-a de ti; pois te é melhor que se perca um dos teus membros do que vá todo o teu corpo para o inferno.
verses.en_web: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
verses.en_bbe: And if your right hand is a cause of trouble to you, let it be cut off and put it away from you; because it is better to undergo the loss of one part, than for all your body to go into hell.

verses.en: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.pt: Também foi dito: Quem repudiar sua mulher, dê-lhe carta de divórcio.
verses.en_web: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
verses.en_bbe: Again, it was said, Whoever puts away his wife has to give her a statement in writing for this purpose:

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que todo aquele que repudia sua mulher, a não ser por causa de infidelidade, a faz adúltera; e quem casar com a repudiada, comete adultério.
verses.en_web: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you that everyone who puts away his wife for any other cause but the loss of her virtue, makes her false to her husband; and whoever takes her as his wife after she is put away, is no true husband to her.

verses.en: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
verses.pt: Outrossim, ouvistes que foi dito aos antigos: Não jurarás falso, mas cumprirás para com o Senhor os teus juramentos.
verses.en_web: “Again you have heard that it was said to them of old time, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
verses.en_bbe: Again, you have knowledge that it was said in old times, Do not take false oaths, but give effect to your oaths to the Lord:

verses.en: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:
verses.pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que de maneira nenhuma jureis; nem pelo céu, porque é o trono de Deus;
verses.en_web: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you, Take no oaths at all: not by the heaven, because it is the seat of God;

verses.en: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.pt: nem pela terra, porque é o escabelo de seus pés; nem por Jerusalém, porque é a cidade do grande Rei;
verses.en_web: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.en_bbe: Or by the earth, because it is the resting-place for his foot; or by Jerusalem, because it is the town of the great King.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.pt: nem jures pela tua cabeça, porque não podes tornar um só cabelo branco ou preto.
verses.en_web: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
verses.en_bbe: You may not take an oath by your head, because you are not able to make one hair white or black.

verses.en: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
verses.pt: Seja, porém, o vosso falar: Sim, sim; não, não; pois o que passa daí, vem do Maligno.
verses.en_web: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
verses.en_bbe: But let your words be simply, Yes or No: and whatever is more than these is of the Evil One.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.pt: Ouvistes que foi dito: Olho por olho, e dente por dente.
verses.en_web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
verses.en_bbe: You have knowledge that it was said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

verses.en: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, vos digo que não resistais ao homem mau; mas a qualquer que te bater na face direita, oferece-lhe também a outra;
verses.en_web: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you, Do not make use of force against an evil man; but to him who gives you a blow on the right side of your face let the left be turned.

verses.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
verses.pt: e ao que quiser pleitear contigo, e tirar-te a túnica, larga-lhe também a capa;
verses.en_web: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
verses.en_bbe: And if any man goes to law with you and takes away your coat, do not keep back your robe from him.

verses.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.pt: e, se qualquer te obrigar a caminhar mil passos, vai com ele dois mil.
verses.en_web: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
verses.en_bbe: And whoever makes you go one mile, go with him two.

verses.en: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.pt: Dá a quem te pedir, e não voltes as costas ao que quiser que lhe emprestes.
verses.en_web: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
verses.en_bbe: Give to him who comes with a request, and keep not your property from him who would for a time make use of it.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
verses.pt: Ouvistes que foi dito: Amarás ao teu próximo, e odiarás ao teu inimigo.
verses.en_web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verses.en_bbe: You have knowledge that it was said, Have love for your neighbour, and hate for him who is against you:

verses.en: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verses.pt: Eu, porém, vos digo: Amai aos vossos inimigos, e orai pelos que vos perseguem;
verses.en_web: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you, Have love for those who are against you, and make prayer for those who are cruel to you;

verses.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.pt: para que vos torneis filhos do vosso Pai que está nos céus; porque ele faz nascer o seu sol sobre maus e bons, e faz chover sobre justos e injustos.
verses.en_web: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
verses.en_bbe: So that you may be the sons of your Father in heaven; for his sun gives light to the evil and to the good, and he sends rain on the upright man and on the sinner.

verses.en: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.pt: Pois, se amardes aos que vos amam, que recompensa tereis? não fazem os publicanos também o mesmo?
verses.en_web: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.en_bbe: For if you have love for those who have love for you, what credit is it to you? do not the tax-farmers the same?

verses.en: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
verses.pt: E, se saudardes somente os vossos irmãos, que fazeis demais? não fazem os gentios também o mesmo?
verses.en_web: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.en_bbe: And if you say, Good day, to your brothers only, what do you do more than others? do not even the Gentiles the same?

verses.en: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
verses.pt: Sede vós, pois, perfeitos, como é perfeito o vosso Pai celestial.
verses.en_web: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
verses.en_bbe: Be then complete in righteousness, even as your Father in heaven is complete.
